lines.dialogue: Hurry up! Come with me! What are you waiting for?! Get in gear!
Shape it up you guys!... Biggs?
I didn't know you were back! When did you get in?
The Academy didn't change you much...but you're back so soon? Hey, what happened, didn't you get your commission?
I almost forgot. There's a battle going on! Right here in our system. Come and look!

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD - SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION -
lines.dialogue: There they are!

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD - SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION -
lines.dialogue: But there was a lot of firing earlier...

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD - SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION -
lines.dialogue: Hey, easy with those...

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: ...so I cut off my power, shut down the afterburners and came in low on Deak's trail. I was so close I thought I was going to fry my instruments. As it was I busted up the Skyhopper pretty bad. Uncle Owen was pretty upset. He grounded me for the rest of the season. You should have been there... it was fantastic.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: Look who's talking. Now that you've been around those giant starships you're beginning to sound like my uncle. You've gotten soft in the city...

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: Well, things haven't been the same since you left, Biggs. It's been so... quiet.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: What are you talking about?

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: Join the Rebellion?! Are you kidding! How?

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: I'm sorry. I'm quiet. Listen how quiet I am. You can barely hear me...

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: You're crazy! You could wander around forever trying to find them.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: And I'm stuck here...

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: Not likely! I had to cancel my application. There has been a lot of unrest among the Sandpeople since you left... they've even raided the outskirts of Anchorhead.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: I know, but he's got enough vaporators going to make the place pay off. He needs me for just one more season. I can't leave him now.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: It couldn't happen here. You said it yourself. The Empire won't bother with this rock.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: I wish I was going... Are you going to be around long?

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: Then I guess I won't see you.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ANCHORHEAD SETTLEMENT - POWER STATION - DAY
lines.dialogue: Well, I'll be at the Academy next season... after that who knows. I won't be drafted into the Imperial Starfleet that's for sure... Take care of yourself, you'll always be the best friend I've got.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: It looks like we don't have much of a choice but I'll remind him.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: But I was going into Toshi Station to pick up some power converters...

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: All right, come on! And the red one, come on. Well, come on, Red, let's go.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Uncle Owen...

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: This R2 unit has a bad motivator. Look!

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Uncle Owen...

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: What about that one?

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Yeah, take it away.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - DESERT - LARS HOMESTEAD - AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Okay, let's go.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: It just isn't fair. Oh, Biggs is right. I'm never gonna get out of here!

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Well, not unless you can alter time, speed up the harvest, or teleport me off this rock!

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Well, if there's a bright center to the universe, you're on the planet that it's farthest from.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Uh, you can call me Luke.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Just Luke.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Hello.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: You got a lot of carbon scoring here. It looks like you boys have seen a lot of action.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: You know of the Rebellion against the Empire?

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Have you been in many battles?

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Well, my little friend, you've got something jammed in here real good. Were you on a cruiser or...

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: What's this?

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Who is she? She's beautiful.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Is there more to this recording?

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Obi-Wan Kenobi? I wonder if he means old Ben Kenobi?

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Well, I don't know anyone named Obi- Wan, but old Ben lives out beyond the dune sea. He's kind of a strange old hermit.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: I wonder who she is. It sounds like she's in trouble. I'd better play back the whole thing.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: H'm? Oh, yeah, well, I guess you're too small to run away on me if I take this off! Okay.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: There you go.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Well, wait a minute. Where'd she go? Bring her back! Play back the entire message.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: All right, I'll be right there, Aunt Beru.

lines.scene: INT. LARS HOMESTEAD - GARAGE AREA - LATE AFTERNOON
lines.dialogue: Well, see what you can do with him. I'll be right back.
You know, I think that R2 unit we bought might have been stolen.
Well, I stumbled across a recording while I was cleaning him. He says he belongs to someone called Obi-Wan Kenobi.
I thought he might have meant old Ben. Do you know what he's talking about? Well, I wonder if he's related to Ben.
But what if this Obi-Wan comes looking for him?
He knew my father?

Yes, sir. I think those new droids are going to work out fine. In fact, I, uh, was also thinking about our agreement about my staying on another season. And if these new droids do work out, I want to transmit my application to the Academy this year.
Sure, there're more than enough droids.
But it's a whole 'nother year.
Yeah, that's what you said last year when Biggs and Tank left.
It looks like I'm going nowhere. I have to finish cleaning those droids.
What are you doing hiding there?
Oh, no!
How could I be so stupid? He's nowhere in sight. Blast it!
It's too dangerous with all the Sandpeople around. We'll have to wait until morning.
All right, I'll be there in a few minutes. Boy, am I gonna get it.
You know that little droid is going to cause me a lot of trouble.

lines.scene: INT./EXT. LUKE'S SPEEDER - DESERT WASTELAND - TRAVELING -
lines.dialogue: How's that.

lines.scene: INT./EXT. LUKE'S SPEEDER - DESERT WASTELAND - TRAVELING -
lines.dialogue: Old Ben Kenobi lives out in this direction somewhere, but I don't see how that R2 unit could have come this far. We must have missed him. Uncle Owen isn't going to take this very well.

lines.scene: INT./EXT. LUKE'S SPEEDER - DESERT WASTELAND - TRAVELING -
lines.dialogue: Sure. He needs you. He'd probably only deactivate you for a day or so...

lines.scene: INT./EXT. LUKE'S SPEEDER - DESERT WASTELAND - TRAVELING -
lines.dialogue: Wait, there's something dead ahead on the scanner. It looks like our droid... hit the accelerator.
Hey, whoa, just where do you think you're going?
Well, come on. It's getting late. I only hope we can get back before Uncle Owen really blows up.
No, he's not going to try anything.
What's wrong with him now?
Sandpeople! Or worst! Come on, let's have a look. Come on.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ROCK CANYON - RIDGE - DAY
lines.dialogue: There are two Banthas down there but I don't see any... wait a second, they're Sandpeople all right. I can see one of them now.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ROCK CANYON - FLOOR - DAY
lines.dialogue: What happened?

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ROCK CANYON - FLOOR - DAY
lines.dialogue: Ben? Ben Kenobi! Boy, am I glad to see you!

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ROCK CANYON - FLOOR - DAY
lines.dialogue: Oh, this little droid! I think he's searching for his former master... I've never seen such devotion in a droid before... there seems to be no stopping him. He claims to be the property of an Obi-Wan Kenobi. Is he a relative of yours? Do you know who he's talking about?

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ROCK CANYON - FLOOR - DAY
lines.dialogue: I think my uncle knew him. He said he was dead.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ROCK CANYON - FLOOR - DAY
lines.dialogue: You know him!

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ROCK CANYON - FLOOR - DAY
lines.dialogue: Then the droid does belong to you.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - ROCK CANYON - FLOOR - DAY
lines.dialogue: Threepio!

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - SAND PIT - ROCK MESA - DAY
lines.dialogue: Can you stand? We've got to get out of here before the Sandpeople return.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - SAND PIT - ROCK MESA - DAY
lines.dialogue: No, you're not. What kind of talk is that?
No, my father didn't fight in the wars. He was a navigator on a spice freighter.
You fought in the Clone Wars?
I wish I'd known him.
Sure, go ahead.
What is it?
How did my father die?
The Force?
I saw part of the message he was...
Alderaan? I'm not going to Alderaan. I've got to go home. It's late, I'm in for it as it is.
I can't get involved! I've got work to do! It's not that I like the Empire. I hate it! But there's nothing I can do about it right now. It's such a long way from here.
Oh, God, my uncle. How am I ever going to explain this?
Look, I can take you as far as Anchorhead. You can get a transport there to Mos Eisley or wherever you're going.
It looks like Sandpeople did this, all right. Look, here are Gaffi sticks, Bantha tracks. It's just... I never heard of them hitting anything this big before.
These are the same Jawas that sold us Artoo and Threepio.
Why would Imperial troops want to slaughter Jawas?
If they traced the robots here, they may have learned who they sold them to. And that would lead them home!
Uncle Owen! Aunt Beru! Uncle Owen!
I want to come with you to Alderaan. There's nothing here for me now. I want to learn the ways of the Force and become a Jedi like my father.
About three or four seasons.
Go on, go on. I can't understand how we got by those troopers. I thought we were dead.
Do you really think we're going to find a pilot here that'll take us to Alderaan?
I'm ready for anything.
What?
Listen, why don't you wait out by the speeder. We don't want any trouble.
I'm sorry.
I'll be careful than.
Ten thousand? We could almost buy our own ship for that!
You bet I could. I'm not such a bad pilot myself! We don't have to sit here and listen...
That's okay. I'm never coming back to this planet again.

lines.scene: EXT. TATOOINE - MOS EISLEY - STREET - ALLEYWAY - USED
lines.dialogue: He says it's the best he can do. Since the XP-38 came out, they're just not in demand.

lines.scene: INT. MOS EISLEY SPACEPORT - DOCKING BAY 94
lines.dialogue: What a piece of junk.
Why don't you outrun them? I thought you said this thing was fast.
Are you kidding? At the rate they're gaining...
What's that flashing?

lines.scene: INT. MILLENNIUM FALCON - CENTRAL HOLD AREA
lines.dialogue: Are you all right? What's wrong?

lines.scene: INT. MILLENNIUM FALCON - CENTRAL HOLD AREA
lines.dialogue: You mean it controls your actions?

lines.scene: INT. MILLENNIUM FALCON - CENTRAL HOLD AREA
lines.dialogue: You don't believe in the Force, do you?

lines.scene: INT. MILLENNIUM FALCON - CENTRAL HOLD AREA
lines.dialogue: With the blast shield down, I can't even see. How am I supposed to fight?

lines.scene: INT. MILLENNIUM FALCON - CENTRAL HOLD AREA
lines.dialogue: You know, I did feel something. I could almost see the remote.
What's going on?
What do you mean? Where is it?
What? How?
Maybe they know what happened.
It followed us!
It sure is leaving in a big hurry. If they identify us, we're in big trouble.
It must have gotten lost, been part of a convoy or something.
Look at him. He's headed for that small moon.
I have a very bad feeling about this.
Why are we still moving towards it?
But there's gotta be something you can do!
Boy, it's lucky you had these compartments.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: You know, between his howling and your blasting everything in sight, it's a wonder the whole station doesn't know we're here.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: I want to go with you.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: But he can...

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Ben is a great man.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: I didn't hear you give any ideas...

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Who do you think...

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: What is it?

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Well, who... who has he found?

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: The princess? She's here?

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Oh, no! We've got to do something.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: The droid belongs to her. She's the one in the message... We've got to help her.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: But he didn't know she was here. Look, will you just find a way back into the detention block?

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: They're going to execute her. Look, a few minutes ago you said you didn't want to just wait here to be captured. Now all you want to do is stay.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: But they're going to kill her!

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: She's rich.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Yes. Rich, powerful! Listen, if you were to rescue her, the reward would be...

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Well more wealth that you can imagine.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: You'll get it!

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: You will...

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: All right.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Uh... Threepio, hand me those binders there will you?

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Okay. Now, I'm going to put these on you.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Okay. Han, you put these on.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - FORWARD BAY - COMMAND OFFICE
lines.dialogue: Lock the door!

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - DETENTION AREA - ELEVATOR TUBE
lines.dialogue: I can't see a thing in this helmet.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - INTERIOR ELEVATOR - DETENTION SECURITY
lines.dialogue: Why didn't you say so before?
Prisoner transfer from Block one-one- three-eight.
He's going to pull us all apart.
What? Oh... the uniform. I'm Luke Skywalker. I'm here to rescue you.
I'm here to rescue you. I've got your R2 unit. I'm here with Ben Kenobi.
Come on!

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - DETENTION AREA - HALLWAY
lines.dialogue: See-Threepio! See-Threepio!

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - DETENTION AREA - HALLWAY
lines.dialogue: We've been cut off! Are there any other ways out of the cell bay?... What was that? I didn't copy!
There isn't any other way out.
Well, I didn't...
No! wait!
Will you forget it? I already tried it. It's magnetically sealed!
There's something alive in here!
Something just moves past my leg! Look! Did you see that?
Help!
Blast it, will you! My gun's jammed.
Anywhere! Oh!!
I don't know, it just let go of me and disappeared...
The walls are moving!
Wait a minute!
Threepio! Come in Threepio! Threepio! Where could he be?
Threepio! Come in, Threepio! Threepio!
Where could he be? Threepio! Threepio, will you come in?
Threepio!

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - MAIN FORWARD BAY - SERVICE PANEL
lines.dialogue: Will you shut up and listen to me? Shut down all garbage mashers on the detention level, will you? Do you copy?
Shut down all the garbage mashers on the detention level.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - MAIN FORWARD BAY - SERVICE PANEL
lines.dialogue: Shut down all the garbage mashers on the detention level.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - MAIN FORWARD BAY - SERVICE PANEL
lines.dialogue: Threepio, we're all right!
We're all right. You did great.
Hey... hey, open the pressure maintenance hatch on unit number... where are we?
Well, let's get moving!
See-Threepio, do you copy?
We're right above you. Stand by.
Where are you going? Come back!
What good will it do us if he gets himself killed? Come on!

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - CENTRAL CORE SHAFT
lines.dialogue: I think we took a wrong turn.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - CENTRAL CORE SHAFT
lines.dialogue: That oughta hold it for a while.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - CENTRAL CORE SHAFT
lines.dialogue: Oh, I think I just blasted it.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - CENTRAL CORE SHAFT
lines.dialogue: Here, hold this.

lines.scene: INT. DEATH STAR - MAIN FORWARD BAY
lines.dialogue: Is the ship all right?
Look!
No!

lines.scene: INT. MILLENNIUM FALCON - CENTRAL HOLD AREA
lines.dialogue: I can't believe he's gone.
They're coming in too fast!
Got him! I got him!
That's it! We did it!
I care!
So... what do you think of her, Han?
Good...
No!

lines.scene: INT. MASSASSI - WAR ROOM BRIEFING AREA
lines.dialogue: It's not impossible. I used to bull's- eye womp rats in my T-sixteen back home. They're not much bigger than two meters.

lines.scene: INT. MASSASSI OUTPOST - MAIN HANGAR DECK
lines.dialogue: So... you got your reward and you're just leaving then?

lines.scene: INT. MASSASSI OUTPOST - MAIN HANGAR DECK
lines.dialogue: Come on! Why don't you take a look around? You know what's about to happen, what they're up against. They could use a good pilot like you. You're turning your back on them.

lines.scene: INT. MASSASSI OUTPOST - MAIN HANGAR DECK
lines.dialogue: All right. Well, take care of yourself, Han. I guess that's what you're best at, isn't it?

lines.scene: INT. MAIN HANGAR DECK - LUKE'S SHIP
lines.dialogue: Oh, it's Han! I don't know, I really thought he'd change his mind.

lines.scene: INT. MAIN HANGAR DECK - LUKE'S SHIP
lines.dialogue: I only wish Ben were here.

lines.scene: INT. MAIN HANGAR DECK - LUKE'S SHIP
lines.dialogue: Biggs! Of course, I'll be up there with you! Listen, have I got some stories to tell...

lines.scene: INT. MAIN HANGAR DECK - LUKE'S SHIP
lines.dialogue: Thank you, sir. I'll try.

lines.scene: INT. MAIN HANGAR DECK - LUKE'S SHIP
lines.dialogue: I told you I'd make it someday, Biggs.

lines.scene: INT. MAIN HANGAR DECK - LUKE'S SHIP
lines.dialogue: Not on your life! That little droid and I have been through a lot together. You okay, Artoo?
Red Five standing by.
This is Red Five; I'm going in!
I got a little cooked, but I'm okay.
I'm on my way in now...
I'm on it.
My scope's negative. I don't see anything.
Hang on, Biggs, I'm coming in.

lines.scene: INT. LUKE'S X-WING FIGHTER - COCKPIT - TRAVELING
lines.dialogue: Got him!
I'm hit, but not bad.
I can't shake him!
Blast it! Wedge where are you?
Thanks, Wedge.
No sign of any... wait!
Coming in point three five.
Red Leader, we're right above you. Turn to point...
...oh-five; we'll cover for you.
Biggs, Wedge, let's close it up. We're going in. We're going in full throttle.
It'll be just like Beggar's Canyon back home.
Watch yourself! Increase speed full throttle!
You worry about those fighters! I'll worry about the tower!
Artoo... that, that stabilizer's broken loose again! See if you can't lock it down!
Get clear, Wedge.
You can't do any more good back there!
Artoo, try and increase the power!
Nothing. I'm all right.
I've lost Artoo!
I knew you'd come back! I just knew it!
Oh, no!
He'll be all right.
Echo Three to Echo Seven. Han, old buddy, do you read me?
Well, I finished my circle. I don't pick up any life readings.
Right. I'll see you shortly. There's a meteorite that hit the ground near here. I want to check it out. It won't take long.
Hey, steady girl. What's the matter? You smell something?
Aaargh!
Ben?
Dagobah system?
Ben... Ben.
Ben... Ben...
Dagobah system...
Dagobah...
Yoda...

lines.scene: INT. REBEL BASE - MEDICAL CENTER - RECOVERY ROOM
lines.dialogue: Thanks to you.
Well, forget the heavy equipment. There's plenty of time to get the smaller modules on the transports.
Thanks.

lines.scene: INT. REBEL BASE - MAIN HANGAR DECK
lines.dialogue: Chewie, take care of yourself, okay?

lines.scene: INT. REBEL BASE - MAIN HANGAR DECK
lines.dialogue: Yeah.

lines.scene: INT. REBEL BASE - MAIN HANGAR DECK
lines.dialogue: You, too.

lines.scene: INT. REBEL BASE - MAIN HANGAR DECK
lines.dialogue: Just like new, Dack. How about you?

lines.scene: INT. REBEL BASE - MAIN HANGAR DECK
lines.dialogue: (quietly, strapping in) I know what you mean.

lines.scene: INT. LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Echo station Five-Seven. We're on our way.

lines.scene: INT. LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: All right, boys, keep tight now.

lines.scene: INT. LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Steady, Dack. Attack pattern delta. Go now!

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: All right, I'm coming in.

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Hobbie, you still with me?

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: That armor's too strong for blasters.

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Rogue Group, use your harpoons and tow cables. Go for the legs. It might be our only chance of stopping them. All right, stand by, Dack.

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Just hang on. Hang on, Dack. Get ready to fire that tow cable.

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Dack? Dack!

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Rogue Three.

lines.scene: INT. WEDGE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE THREE - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Wedge, I've lost my gunner. You'll have to make this shot. I'll cover for you. Set your harpoon. Follow me on the next pass.

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Steady, Rogue Two

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: I see it, Wedge. Good work.

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Rogue Two, are you all right?

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: We'll set harpoon. I'll cover for you.

lines.scene: INT.  LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Watch that cross fire, boys.

lines.scene: INT. ZEV'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE TWO - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Stay tight and low.

lines.scene: INT. LUKE'S SNOWSPEEDER, ROGUE LEADER - COCKPIT
lines.dialogue: Hobbie, I've been hit!
Artoo! Get her ready for takeoff.
Don't worry, Artoo. We're going, we're going.
There's nothing wrong, Artoo. I'm just setting a new course.
We're not going to regroup with the others.
We're going to the Dagobah system.
Yes, Artoo?
That's all right. I'd like to keep it on manual control for a while.
Yes, that's it. Dagobah.
No, I'm not going to change my mind about this. I'm not picking up any cities or technology. Massive life-form readings, though. There's something alive down there...
Yes, I'm sure it's perfectly safe for droids.
I know, I know! All the scopes are dead. I can't see a thing! Just hang on, I'm going to start the landing cycle...
No, Artoo, you stay put. I'll have a look around.
Artoo?
Artoo! Where are you?
Artoo! You be more careful.
Artoo - that way!
Artoo!
Oh, no! Are you all right? Come on. You're lucky you don't taste very good. Anything broken?
If you're saying coming here was a bad idea, I'm beginning to agree with you. Oh, Artoo, what are we doing here? It's like... something out of a dream, or, I don't know. Maybe I'm just going crazy.
Ready for some power? Okay. Let's see now. Put that in there. There you go.
Now all I have to do is find this Yoda... if he even exists.
Still... there's something familiar about this place. I feel like... I don't know...
(looking at the creature) Like we're being watched!
I'm looking for someone.
(Trying to keep from smiling) Right.
I don't think so. I'm looking for a great warrior.
Put that down. Hey! That's my dinner!
Listen, friend, we didn't mean to land in that puddle, and if we could get our ship out, we would, but we can't, so why don't you just...
Hey, you could have broken this. Don't do that. Ohhh... you're making a mess. Hey, give me that!
I don't want your help. I want my lamp back. I'll need it to get out of this slimy mudhole.
Oh, Artoo, let him have it!
Artoo!
Now will you move along, little fella? We're got a lot of work to do.
I'm not looking for a friend. I'm looking for a Jedi Master.
You know him?
Stay here and watch after the camp, Artoo.
Look, I'm sure it's delicious. I just don't understand why we can't see Yoda now.
How far away is Yoda? Will it take us long to get there?
Mostly because of my father, I guess.
Oh, come on. How could you know my father? You don't even know who I am. Oh, I don't know what I'm doing here. We're wasting our time.
Yoda! I am ready. I... Ben! I can be a Jedi. Ben, tell him I'm ready.
But I've learned so much.
I won't fail you - I'm not afraid.
Vader. Is the dark side stronger?
But how am I to know the good side from the bad?
But tell me why I can't...
There's something not right here.
I feel cold, death.
What's in there?
Oh, no. We'll never get it out now.
Master, moving stones around is one thing. This is totally different.
All right, I'll give it a try.
I can't. It's too big.
You want the impossible.
I don't... I don't believe it.
Han! Leia!
I saw... I saw a city in the clouds.
They were in pain.
Future? Will they die?
I've got to go to them.
I can't keep the vision out of my head. They're my friends. I've got to help them.
But Han and Leia will die if I don't.
But I can help them! I feel the Force!
But I've learned so much since then. Master Yoda, I promise to return and finish what I've begun. You have my word.
And that is why I have to go.
You won't.
And sacrifice Han and Leia?
I understand. (he moves to his X-wing) Artoo, fire up the converters.
I will. And I'll return. I promise.
No, Threepio's with them.
Just hang on. We're almost there.
You'll find I'm full of surprises.
No!

lines.scene: INT. GANTRY - OUTSIDE CONTROL ROOM - REACTOR SHAFT
lines.dialogue: I'll never join you!

lines.scene: INT. GANTRY - OUTSIDE CONTROL ROOM - REACTOR SHAFT
lines.dialogue: He told me enough! It was you who killed him.

lines.scene: INT. GANTRY - OUTSIDE CONTROL ROOM - REACTOR SHAFT
lines.dialogue: No. No. That's not true! That's impossible!

lines.scene: INT. GANTRY - OUTSIDE CONTROL ROOM - REACTOR SHAFT
lines.dialogue: No! No! No!

lines.scene: EXT. BOTTOM OF CLOUD CITY - WEATHER VANE - DUSK
lines.dialogue: Ben... Ben, please!

lines.scene: EXT. BOTTOM OF CLOUD CITY - WEATHER VANE - DUSK
lines.dialogue: Ben. Leia!

lines.scene: EXT. BOTTOM OF CLOUD CITY - WEATHER VANE - DUSK
lines.dialogue: Hear me! Leia!
Oh, Leia.
Father.
Ben, why didn't you tell me?
It's Vader.
Ben, why didn't you tell me?
Good luck, Lando
I'll meet you at the rendezvous point on Tatooine.
Chewie, I'll be waiting for your signal.
Take care, you two. May the Force be with you.
Ow!

Greetings, Exalted One. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight and friend to Captain Solo. I know that you are powerful, mighty Jabba, and that your anger with Solo must be equally powerful. I seek an audience with Your Greatness to bargain for Solo's life. With your wisdom, I'm sure that we can work out an arrangement which will be mutually beneficial and enable us to avoid any unpleasant confrontation. As a token of my goodwill, I present to you a gift: these two droids.
I must speak with Jabba.
You will take me to Jabba now!
You serve your master well.
And you will be rewarded.
I must be allowed to speak.
You will bring Captain Solo and the Wookiee to me.
Nevertheless, I'm taking Captain Solo and his friends. You can either profit by this... or be destroyed! It's your choice. But I warn you not to underestimate my powers.
Han!
Are you all right?
Wouldn't miss it.
The same as always.
You should have bargained, Jabba. That's the last mistake you'll ever make.
There's nothing to see. I used to live here, you know.
Just stick close to Chewie and Lando. I've taken care of everything.
Jabba! This is your last chance. Free us or die.
Easy, Chewie.
Point it at the deck!
Come on!
Let's go! And don't forget the droids.
I have a promise I have to keep first... to an old friend.
I'll meet you back at the fleet.
I will.
That's right, Artoo. We're going to the Dagobah system. I have a promise to keep... to an old friend.
No... of course not.
Master Yoda, you can't die.
But I need your help. I've come back to complete the training.
Then I am a Jedi?
Master Yoda... is Darth Vader my father?
Yoda, I must know.
Yes.
Unfortunate that I know the truth?
Well, I'm sorry.
I can't do it, Artoo. I can't go on alone.
Obi-Wan! Why didn't you tell me?
You told me Vader betrayed and murdered my father.
There's still good in him.
I can't do it, Ben.
I tried to stop him once. I couldn't do it.
But I had to help my friends.
I can't kill my own father.
Yoda spoke of another.
But I have no sister.
Leia! Leia's my sister.
But you can't let her get involved now, Ben. Vader will destroy her.
Hi, Han... Chewie.
Yeah, she's comin' up.
All set.
Vader's on that ship.
I'm endangering the mission. I shouldn't have come.
Quietly, there might be more of them out there.
I see them. Wait, Leia!
Move closer!
Get alongside that one!
Get him!
We got separated.
Hey, we better go look for her.
Come on, Artoo. We'll need your scanners.
There's two more wrecked speeders back there. And I found this.
Chewie, wa-wait! Don't!
Will you take it easy? Let's just figure out a way to get out of this thing. Han, can you reach my lightsaber?
Han, don't. It'll be all right.
Chewie, give 'em your crossbow.
Do you understand anything they're saying?
Threepio, tell them if they don't do as you wish, you'll become angry and use your magic.
Just tell them.
Thanks, Threepio.
Leia... do you remember your mother? Your real mother?
What do you remember?
Tell me.
I have no memory of my mother. I never knew her.
Vader is here...now, on this moon.
I felt his presence. He's come for me. He can feel when I'm near. That's why I have to go. As long as I stay, I'm endangering the group and our mission here. I have to face him.
He's my father.
There's more. It won't be easy for you to hear it, but you must. If I don't make it back, you're the only hope for the Alliance.
You're wrong, Leia. You have that power too. In time you'll learn to use it as I have. The Force is strong in my family. My father has it...I have it...and...my sister has it.
Yes. It's you Leia.
Then you know why I have to face him.
No, you don't. You've always been strong.
Because...there is good in him. I've felt it. He won't turn me over to the Emperor. I can save him. I can turn him back to the good side. I have to try.
I know, father.

It is the name of your true self. You've only forgotten. I know there is good in you. The Emperor hasn't driven it from you fully. That is why you couldn't destroy me. That's why you won't bring me to your Emperor now.
Come with me.
I will not turn...and you'll be forced to kill me.
Search your feelings, father. You can't do this. I feel the conflict within you. Let go of your hate.
Then my father is truly dead.
You're gravely mistaken. You won't convert me as you did my father.
You're wrong. Soon I'll be dead...and you with me.
Your overconfidence is your weakness.
No!
I will not fight you, father.
Your thoughts betray you, father. I feel the good in you...the conflict.
You couldn't bring yourself to kill me before, and I don't believe you'll destroy me now.
I will not fight you.
Never-r-r!
Never! I'll never turn to the dark side. You've failed, Your Highness. I am a Jedi, like my father before me.
No. You're coming with me. I can't leave you here. I've got to save you.
Father...I won't leave you.
